composition_variation: Feature an original 25-year-old anime woman with a dark braided ponytail, pausing gracefully on roller skates along an empty seaside boardwalk. She wears a mint helmet, opaque long-sleeved athletic jacket, loose full-length pants, wrist guards, and knee protection. Use fresh cel shading, turquoise sea, coral skate accents, and bright morning light. Her balanced stance is confident and playful, with one open hand raised in greeting. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
